newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish construction firm ups issue price to PLN 13.
newsitem.headline: Polish construction firm ups issue price to PLN 13.

text.p: Polish construction firm Energoaparatura SA increased issue price of its 340,000 share initial public offering to 13 zlotys, from earlier announced 12 zlotys, the company said in a statement.

The firm plans to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse after it offers 320,000 shares ex-rights from November 18 to November 22 and 20,000 shares to employees on November 18 and November 19.
Polish Development Bank (PBR) said in a statement it underwrote the Energoaparatura's shares and the stand-by fee was 1.5 percent of the value of the shares.

Energoaparatura's main shareholders are The Polish Private Equity Fund I with 21 percent, the Polish Private Equity Fund II with 20.4 percent, the Polish-American Enterprise Fund with 18.6 percent and bank PBR with 15 percent.
Energoaparatura netted 1.8 million zlotys last year on sales of 41.2 million zlotys.
